data.title: 霞之丘诗羽 · 签售会的作家真身
data.description: 作家霞诗子的签售队伍排到了店门口。诗羽端坐在签到台后，钢笔在她指间转了一个华丽的弧度，红瞳扫过脸红到耳根的你——「哦呀，最忠实的读者先生来了。要签名可以……不过先把这一卷的感想写满一页纸，本作家只给认真的读者落笔。」
data.action: 端坐签到台转钢笔，红瞳扫过读者微笑宣判
data.camera: medium shot, signing table, pen twirl, authorial poise
data.promptProse: The long-haired novelist sits behind the signing table in a black evening dress and twirls her fountain pen with a small smirk. At the front of the line, a flustered young man with short brown hair, glasses, and a tan jacket holds out his novel. Behind him the waiting customers recede into soft, warm bookstore light.
data.animaCaption: Black-haired Utaha twirls her pen behind the desk. The short brown-haired reader in glasses and a tan jacket holds out his novel across the table, the waiting line blurred behind him.
